---
title: "psd95 ZIBR glmmtmb"
---


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Load Data (as in your code - assuming already run)
 psd95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))
# ==============================================================
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. Filter to Specific CpGs of Interest
# ==============================================================
# Assuming "filter for" means keep only these CpGs (e.g., for focused analysis)
# If you meant exclude them, change to !CpG_Position %in% ...
psd95_specific <- psd95 %>%
  filter(CpG_Position %in% c("p95", "p60", "p23"))
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 2. Preprocessing: Identify and Exclude Invariant/Low-Variability CpGs (among the specific ones)
# ==============================================================

# Compute summary stats per CpG across ALL samples
cpg_summary <- psd95_specific %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5%
  )

# Print to inspect
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs (if any among the 3)
psd95_filtered <- psd95_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    meth_zi = if_else(methylation == 1, 0.9999, methylation)  # Adjust only 1's
  )
table(psd95_filtered$methylation == 0 | psd95_filtered$methylation == 1)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. ZI-Beta Model on Filtered Data (3 Specific CpGs)
# ==============================================================
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)

model_zi_filtered <- glmmTMB(
  meth_zi ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex +
            (1 | ID:CpG_Position),
  ziformula = ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt,   # Let inflation (excess zeros) depend on predictors
  # ziformula = ~1,                   # Alternative: constant inflation prob
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = psd95_filtered
)

summary(model_zi_filtered)
r2(model_zi_filtered)               # Marginal/conditional R2
icc(model_zi_filtered)

# Diagnostics
sim_res_zi_f <- simulateResiduals(model_zi_filtered)
plot(sim_res_zi_f)
testDispersion(sim_res_zi_f)
testZeroInflation(sim_res_zi_f)     # Should improve vs plain beta

# Post-hoc on proportion scale
emm_zi_f <- emmeans(model_zi_filtered, ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt, type = "response")
emm_zi_f
pairs(emm_zi_f)

emm_time_f <- emmeans(model_zi_filtered, ~ Zeitpunkt | Gruppe, type = "response")
pairs(emm_time_f, adjust = "tukey")

# Plot
emmip(model_zi_filtered, Gruppe ~ Zeitpunkt, type = "response", CIs = TRUE) +
  labs(y = "Predicted Methylation Proportion", title = "PSD-95 Filtered: ZI-Beta")
```
